tweet.text: METR completed a pre-deployment evaluation of GPT-5.1-Codex-Max & found its capabilities consistent with past trends. If our projections hold, we expect further OpenAI development in the next 6 months is unlikely to pose catastrophic risk via automated AI R&D or rogue autonomy.
